title: Design System: Editorial Issue Grid Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero positioning headline and case study titles.

headline.purpose: Major editorial section titles and admin page headers.

title.purpose: Numbered project entries and card headings.

body.purpose: Editorial paragraphs, bio, and sanitized Markdown prose.

label.purpose: Navigation anchors, tabular numbers, stack tags, and controls.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Crisp color and border state changes on editorial controls.

motion.name: media-hover
motion.purpose: Subtle 1.015x scale on linked project plates.

components.name: Primary Editorial Button
components.description: Solid vermilion rectangular CTA used for Download CV, Inspect Case Studies, and primary saves.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--spot-accent, #e54814); color: var(--spot-ink, #ffffff); border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--spot-accent-hover, #c93b0d); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spot-accent, #e54814); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Hairline Button
components.description: Sharp 1px bordered link/button used for direct contact channels and secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--ink-primary, #0d0d0d); border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #1a1a1a); border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 18px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--ink-primary, #0d0d0d); color: var(--bg-page, #f4f3ef); }

components.name: NDA Restriction Badge
components.description: High-contrast vermilion status stamp identifying NDA-protected engineering case studies.
components.css: .ds-badge-nda { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--spot-accent, #e54814); color: var(--spot-ink, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--spot-accent, #e54814); border-radius: 0; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Segmented Locale Switch
components.description: Crisp 1px rectangular EN | ID language toggle in the Editorial Spine.
components.css: .ds-locale { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #1a1a1a); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; } .ds-locale-active { background: var(--ink-primary, #0d0d0d); color: var(--bg-page, #f4f3ef); padding: 6px 10px; } .ds-locale-item { border-left: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #1a1a1a); color: var(--ink-primary, #0d0d0d); padding: 6px 10px; }

components.name: Editorial Text Input
components.description: Sharp rectangular input field used in /admin login, profile, and project editors.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="e.g. Distributed Settlement Platform" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--bg-page, #f4f3ef); color: var(--ink-primary, #0d0d0d); border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #1a1a1a); border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; caret-color: var(--spot-accent, #e54814); } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--spot-accent, #e54814); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: This system adapts mid-century editorial magazine grids into a bilingual (EN/ID) technical portfolio and single-owner /admin workspace. Pages are organized like printed architectural folios with crisp serif display headlines, structured two-column indexes separated by decisive 1px and 3px rules, and a permanent left editorial spine on desktop.
keyCharacteristics: Permanent 264px left editorial spine on desktop, collapsing into a sticky compact header and drawer on mobile.
Sharp rectangular geometry (0px border radius) with zero drop shadows.
Self-hosted Bodoni Moda, Hanken Grotesk, and JetBrains Mono typography.
Shared semantic Light and Dark tokens across public routes and /admin.

rules.name: The One Spot Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is reserved strictly for active markers, primary CTAs, and NDA seals.

rules.name: The Dual-Ground Parity Rule
rules.body: Every surface, border, and text token maps 1-to-1 between Light and Dark themes with >=4.5:1 body contrast.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings carry their own weight without decorative kicker labels stacked above them.

rules.name: The Flat-Rule Rule
rules.body: Never add drop shadows, glowing borders, or blurred glass cards; separate planes with crisp 1px or 3px rules.

dos: Do preserve 0px rectangular corners and crisp 1px/3px rules across both public and /admin views.
Do keep all typography self-hosted under apps/web/static/fonts/ with @font-face rules in apps/web/src/app.css.
Do use authored inline SVG icons (Icon.svelte) with uniform 1.75 stroke weight rather than Unicode glyphs or emoji.
Do keep empty states clean and honest when no projects, work history, or profile copy have been populated.
donts: Don't introduce drop shadows, gradient text, pill-shaped marketing cards, or glassmorphism.
Don't place kicker/eyebrow labels above section headings.
Don't expose repoUrl or liveUrl in public payloads or UI when isNda is true.
